rules: Reuse the existing EMA1h and fixed/adaptive Donchian signal functions; preserve frozen old sources and experiments.
Hourly closed signals, minute execution, fixed2min delay after signal for causal logging and30sec settlement buffer. Not an exact replay of older1h fills.
Risk1%,10x,R$1000 per independent portfolio; stops1.5ATR,target2R,max24h,cooldown4h. Corrected funding engine, modeled fees/slippage and contract-specific current filters.
Keep cost filter: stop distance / round-trip costs including funding reserve >=4, evaluated for each cost scenario; opposite exit signals always remain.
ETH BTC-context veto requires trailing72h correlation>=0.60 and BTC1h/4h both against entry; BTC own-trend variant requires both BTC1h/4h against entry, without self-correlation.

Sentiment model/revision and thresholds inherited from the local fixed model. Additionally deduplicate canonical article URLs and normalized titles, preserving earliest received version; do not change prior experiments.
Separate all4variants to measure BTC and sentiment independently; missing/expired/future/insufficient news does not veto, mark uncovered. No historical news backfill.
Original G151 forests were trained for5min signals and are not used to score hourly signals. No new RF fit or genetic search in this stage.
Historical BTC-context ablation is exploratory on already-seen Jun-Sep2026. Compare all strategies, including losses and inactive portfolios. No automatic winner promotion.
Longer holding does not imply higher probability of success; trading frequency, gross returns, fees, slippage, funding, drawdown and sample size are reported.
No real orders, paid AI or account keys. Honor local pause; never restart original server or edit private DB. Missing decisions are explicit and never filled retroactively.
